title: Corrections module: Clone, Heal, the repair stage and frozen patches
objective: Deliver and independently qualify offline, non-destructive Clone/Heal through the current module, catalog and shared brush contracts, with GPU rendering within the declared CPU-reference tolerance and UI/API parity; separately provide the same repair layer's frozen-patch and bounded candidate foundation for AI editing.
context_summary: Planning review only, not implementation authorization. The owner decided on 2026-10-05: repair after source development and before colour in content coordinates, deletion of PointReplace, stale patches kept rendering with an explicit export acknowledgement, and remote consent remembered per provider profile/data class. Clone/Heal remain an independently deliverable offline slice; the owner decided repair before Detail, the spatial GPU qualification class and exclusion of correction operations from presets on 2026-10-07. Reuse the delivered generic path grid, typed stroke store, StrokeCarrier and DraftTarget, centralized compiled render boundaries, module capabilities/artifacts, catalog format 13, Develop/prepare/adopt flow, Locate and single/batch JPEG exporter. What remains is Corrections' production brush descriptor and operation identities, repair-layer stroke discovery/admission/hydration and cleanup, bounded arbitrary source reads and Heal solves, the actual module/workflow, and frozen patches with an intra-layer input-prefix identity and bounded candidate jobs. Renderer integration targets the GPU renderer of record, its tile service, window and staged-sweep planners, incremental chains, warm-up and gpu-qualification beside AI editing; contract/numerical work can start independently. Current per-asset remote grants are changed by AI editing's remote tier, not this offline work. Model/provider tasks remain cancelled here and owned by AI editing; no cross-file task IDs are used.

tasks.description: Freeze the remaining Corrections contract against the current module, catalog, geometry and GPU-first interfaces, preserving settled owner decisions.
extra_context: The owner has already decided the repair stage relative to source/colour, deletion of PointReplace, stale patches kept rendering and provider-profile consent. Do not reopen these or restore the old fail-on-stale, licence gate or two-provider rollout.

The owner decided repair before Detail restoration on 2026-10-07: Detail treats repaired and original regions together, its changes do not stale patches, and a repair tick reruns its downstream link. Measure that rerun cost, GPU chain/staged-sweep costs and the reference mask-input grid prefix; preserve the decided placement in the operation and patch-input contract.

Freeze a single repair effect with ordered stable operation IDs, action and draft bindings, one-entry history labels, content-space geometry and source-handle behaviour. Existing module identity parameters are host-only and draft.begin accepts mask/component only; the production extension is assigned to the shared-brush task.

The frozen-patch identity includes verified source fingerprint/interpretation/development, dimensions, upstream relevant layers/masks and earlier operations inside the same repair layer. spatial::prefix_hash alone hashes only layers/masks; same-byte Locate, later operations, unrelated masks and downstream adjustments must not invalidate a patch.

Freeze the bounded candidate/read/accept seam and stale acknowledgements for export.plan, export.jpeg and batch.export. These are proposed extensions of shipped APIs, not existing commands. Keep Clone/Heal qualification independent of frozen patches and all model/provider delivery.

Contract/numerical work can start now. Renderer code integrates with the GPU renderer of record and its release gate, cargo xtask gpu-qualification. The CPU production paths are retired; the CPU proxy remains only the drag path of a session without a GPU, and is not a Corrections dependency.

ActionDescriptor::preset is already an eligibility gate independent of patch syntax. The owner decided preset: false for photograph-bound correction operations on 2026-10-07. Preserve ordinary adjustment preset application over existing repairs; retouch-preset and Lightroom spot conversion remain outside scope.

The owner accepted the existing spatial GPU qualification class for Clone, Heal and the frozen-patch composite on 2026-10-07. Reduced-stage repair drags follow the accepted GPU-first motion contract: report motion differences separately and retain the strict at-rest gate; do not widen a limit or claim measured motion misses pass it.

tasks.description: Select and freeze the Clone and Heal numerical contract against independent references.
extra_context: Clone/Heal are useful offline even if AI delivery is delayed. Study the exact CPU reference in the current byte/linear domains and a solver that the GPU implementation can reproduce within the declared tolerance.

Reuse path::capture_grid and typed StrokeKind storage; Corrections owns radius, feather/opacity, source offset and edge handling, not the mask brush's flow/colour limits. Study the accepted repair-before-Detail placement and measure downstream rerun cost.
Numerical study and solver-cost bounds are this task's subject and can be measured here. Whole-editor timing waits until the delivered feature is finished.

The GPU is the renderer of record. The frozen solver must have a bounded window/tile/staged-sweep GPU form within the declared CPU-reference tolerance and a measured photo-sized per-tick cost suitable for drawing strokes on the GPU. The current spatial convention permits four inputs per pass, eleven apply planes per operation and 1,024 shared workgroup values (render/gpu/spatial.rs); arbitrary source regions require a declared extension, not assumed edge-clamped lf_plane reads. Record GPU tick and CPU solve bounds without choosing an unanswered product policy.

tasks.description: Add the narrow repair stage and bounded regional processing primitive.
extra_context: The GPU renders the picture at every zoom, the histogram and clipping counts, pixel reads and export; the CPU is the whole-frame reference, held to exact fixtures, and the fallback. Add a CPU reference unit and module-owned WGSL, Clone/Heal corpus families for gpu-qualification, reads through the tile service and export through the GPU tile worker with the reference fallback. Add no CPU production proxy, cache or point path.

The stage-boundary dispatch is already centralized in render/compiled.rs and the shared pipeline. Extend it; no other group must first refactor thirty render matches. Delete the developer-only pixel proof/PointReplace with the repair stage, and explicitly refuse unsupported data without rewriting it. Remove the obsolete PixelStage and PointReplacement fallback branches with PointReplace, while retaining truthful fallback/refusal for unsupported work.

Current spatial work reads an output rectangle plus a bounded halo. Clone may read a distant source rectangle, and Heal needs per-patch scratch/iterations; declare and reserve all input regions and GPU resources rather than inflating MAX_SPATIAL_HALO or allocating unbounded intermediates. Entry::plan_gpu_window and SpatialEntry::halo_reads currently return one halo-grown rectangle; staged sweeps split by accumulated reach and staged-light dependencies, and GpuChange recognises mask-local changes while other operation-word changes become Anywhere. Extend these contracts for distant reads, source-to-destination change propagation and a Heal solve changing its whole patch; a brush tip rectangle alone cannot describe them. Extend the reference mask-input prefix in render/input_grid.rs to include repair in the chosen placement and key, rather than falling back to per-cell spatial evaluation.

Reuse rendering limits, shared pool and reserve-before-allocate rules. The reference renderer's 256 MiB spatial budget paces its tiles; the GPU-preview budget is 2 GiB, the tile worker has its own separate 2 GiB budget and a held boundary is bounded to 256 MiB. Declare and charge repair reads, stage textures and solves on both devices. Any new budget or reduced-stage approximation needs the frozen contract and measurement, not an assumption.

New CPU reference passes use their own luxforge_raw::RenderPass and measured parallel gate; RAW development scheduling is not a render executor. Answer the performance-rules checklist at the finished handoff.

Extend GPU stage classification and plan_warm_list for repair and operation actions: current warm-up enumerates Color/Finish and Restoration/Spatial drags, and first-use layers only for field-patch actions. Warm repair strokes and source-handle edits at open and after commits; merely adding WGSL does not cover the first tick.

The Corrections workspace proposes 100 corrections per photograph (owner review pending). Size the repair pass so many operations evaluate in one dispatch, for example from a bounded operation table with per-operation source windows, rather than one charged output plane per operation; publish the declared limit for the desktop and refusal instead of hard-coding it.

tasks.description: Extend the existing brush capture with a declared Corrections interaction, validated operation identities and shared draft bindings.
extra_context: The generic path grid, StrokeKind/StrokeTable/StrokeCarrier and DraftTarget/declared_target are implemented. Reuse them; the test-only path::tests::RepairStroke proves storage generality, not production Corrections.

What is missing: a production brush-mask CanvasInteraction, an operation identity admitted on the relevant module actions, public draft.begin support for that identity, and descriptor-directed desktop brush/source-handle capture. Keep unrelated host-only json/text/identity restrictions intact.

Generalize mask_draft/brush.rs plumbing instead of creating a second brush, store or draft system. Corrections owns its radius/opacity/feather/source parameters; the mask brush keeps its flow/colour-limit behaviour.

Use the shared core geometry map and warped-path drawing for capture, source handles and overlays through Lens/Perspective/crop/straighten/orientation. Correlate mapping to the displayed entry/draft, and refuse invalid or stale mappings.

This task can prove the generic descriptor/capture with a test consumer before the module exists. The actual production section, operation selection and smoke journey are the offline workflow task; expose no placeholder feature.

Existing mask strokes draw on GPU chains through incremental change rectangles; preserve that consumer while adding repair declarations. Its measured paint cost is not a Corrections result. Correlate overlay, drafted action, GPU frame and fallback reason; test-consumer capture alone does not qualify production repair pixels.

The desktop interaction is designed in the Corrections workspace: the brush is always in hand, a press away from a pin always adds, ⌥-click sets a persistent source with a following crosshair, ⌘-drag places a spot and pulls out its source, ⇧-click draws straight strokes, and pins/source pins/size handles select and drag with one draft per gesture. Bind capture, hit order and handle drags to those rules; no numeric ID entry, no right-click source.

tasks.description: Implement the corrections module's ordered Clone/Heal operations and edit actions.
extra_context: One single repair effect owns ordered stable operation IDs. ToolModule owns validation/plan/compile/labels; the host persists full snapshots with existing revision envelopes and durable asset-action retries.

Declare a Corrections StrokeKind and repair-layer StrokeCarrier and list it in Recipe::stroke_references. Extend admission, catalog fresh-only storage and hydration; a missing/corrupt/wrong-type stroke names its operation and does not become an empty repair.

The catalog is format 13. Files enter through pick.develop/source.prepare/job.adopt; EditorService::import is the blocking helper for the same flow. Preparation and artifact binding remain the shared paths; module code never reads an original or writes catalog tables.

catalog.empty-removed currently gates its conservative stroke-address scan on the serialized strokes key. Preserve that declared carrier shape or extend discovery, with mixed mask/repair and cross-photograph retention tests; do not add a second store or collector.

Same-byte source.locate/folder recovery preserves edits and identities. Missing/offline/changed originals fail source verification. Library Remove/Put back and undo retain edits; Send back refuses an edited photograph.

Follow the frozen preset-eligibility policy through the existing ActionDescriptor::preset/ModuleRegistry::patch_action gate. Ordinary adjustment preset application must retain correction layers/resources and invoke the same upstream recomputation/invalidation rules; no new photo-bound retouch preset importer is added.

Implement the workspace's contract changes: add-correction with source omitted resolves an automatic source on a render worker against the request's revision (never on the owner or UI thread) and stores it as an ordinary offset with source-origin auto/set; update-correction accepts a replacement path to move the destination while preserving the source position; query.correction-sources returns ranked candidates without writing. The candidate set, rejection rules, score and tie-break are deterministic and need exact reference fixtures; no-source is an explicit outcome.

tasks.description: Extend the delivered repair layer with frozen patches, bounded candidate jobs, input invalidation and stale-export acknowledgement.

Derived artifacts are implemented: worker-side ModuleContext publication, host catalog rows/references, source-worker preparation, 256 MiB/4096 prepared-artifact admission and collection of unreferenced objects. Reuse their crash, catalog-ID, live-task and Empty Removed contracts.

The current task result is JSON plus artifact IDs; disposable candidate pixels need a bounded host job-result store with discoverable handles/read/accept semantics. Implement only that shared seam with a deterministic test producer, at AI editing's accepted starting bounds of four 64 MiB candidates per job and 1 GiB across jobs, including previews/ownership and explicit release reporting. Publish accepted bytes on a worker and recheck asset existence/revision and exact input-prefix identity at the ordinary commit. Cancellation, stale/late results or Empty Removed cannot partially mutate or resurrect an asset. Publication before a refused commit can leave only an unreferenced object.

spatial::prefix_hash does not include source interpretation/development identity or earlier operations inside the same repair layer. Extend identity as frozen by the contract; later operations, unrelated masks, downstream colour/geometry and same-byte Locate do not stale a patch.

Extend existing export.plan/export.jpeg and batch.export with entry/operation-specific acknowledgement; missing/corrupt artifacts still fail source-unavailable. Only job.read/job.cancel read and cancel export jobs; export.read/export.cancel do not exist.

This foundation needs neither a real model nor remote consent/runtime activation. Test bounded publication/acceptance, offline evaluation and catalog movement through a test producer. Full AI model/provider journeys stay in AI editing.

acceptance_criteria: A test producer publishes candidates through bounded host storage, with declared address/read/accept schemas, accurate release reporting and safe ownership during concurrent reads/accept/cancel/disconnect; no candidate pixels enter JSON or durable artifacts before acceptance.

Validated accepted bytes/coverage/transform/provenance and the exact input-prefix identity are referenced by one ordinary atomic repair/history commit after worker publication and revision checks; crash/failure creates no partial edit.

The patch CPU reference preserves outside-coverage pixels exactly and continuous RAW precision elsewhere. Its module-owned WGSL meets the owner-frozen reference tolerance through gpu-qualification on a required patch corpus family for display, histogram/clipping, samples and export; prepared patch/coverage bytes are available and charged on both GPU devices, and catalog tiers and warm-up include accepted/reopened patches.

RAW source-development and earlier intra-layer/layer input changes mark patches stale while rendering them; later operations, downstream edits, unrelated masks and same-byte source relocation do not. recipe.describe, operation rows and status explain the condition.

Single and batch export disclose stale operation identities and require the frozen-entry acknowledgement; a race invalidates an old acknowledgement rather than silently exporting a different stale result.

Offline/model-absent reopen, history/versions/restore, typed preparation, missing/corrupt artifacts, prepared-byte limits, catalog-with-artifacts relocation and Remove/Put back/Empty Removed retain or collect resources correctly.
Native background rendered/API checks with a test producer prove the frozen-patch and candidate seam; real model/provider behaviour remains unclaimed and does not gate offline Clone/Heal.

steps: Add focused candidate budget/ownership, intra-layer invalidation, atomic acceptance, artifact recovery and stale single/batch export tests with a deterministic producer; use only affected test binaries/filters while building.
Run native GPU-reference comparisons and background rendered journeys at integration, including crash/cancel/revision races and removal/source recovery; quick once at handoff.
Measure candidate/publication and patch-render memory/cost after this foundation is finished, independently of later model inference.
commands: cargo run --release --locked --package xtask -- verify --tier rendered --output NEW_DIR
expected_results: One durable frozen-patch and bounded candidate foundation with truthful stale/export behaviour and no model dependency.

JPEG export and batch.export are shipped; acceptance exports actual files through export.plan/export.jpeg and job.read/job.cancel, compares pixels against the reference within declared GPU tolerances and proves originals are unchanged.

Naturalness, exact CPU numerics and GPU correctness are distinct evidence. Headless/VM functional evidence does not establish native GPU output or platform performance. Answer the crates performance checklist for the integrated change. gpu-qualification runs in rendered/full; ensure the new required Clone/Heal families and Corrections timing components are registered before the milestone run. Current mask-paint distributions are comparison evidence, not a repair latency guarantee.
